Second-Hand Fishing Skiff Transfer

Name: Gullsong
Specs: 8m, wooden fishing boat, twin engines (replaced last year)
Features: Latest navigation system, basic cold storage, full set of netting tools
Owner's Note: This boat has sailed with me for seven years. Well-maintained and deeply loved. My kids are insisting I retire to Duomension City, so I'm looking for a new owner who truly understands the sea. Price negotiable, test sails available.
Contact: Add my social media account "@SunsetRetiree" to get in touch. Looking for a good match.


One-Day Inshore Tour

Still following those online guides, hitting all the usual spots, and ordering the same tired dishes everywhere?
Want to see the beautiful reefs and beaches that the ordinary tourist routes miss?
We are a family of local fishermen, born and raised here, and we're dedicated to offering you a unique tour experience!
Contact: The third boat to dock at the pier every evening. The secret passphrase is: "I can't swim. How about you?"


"Seawave Apartments" Long-Term Rental
Location: Seaside building on the west side of the port. Open the window for an ocean view.
Layout: One bedroom, one living room. Includes a kitchenette and a washroom. Fully furnished, and features a private scenic terrace.
Rent: 10,000 Credits/Month
Contact: With social anxiety, so don't contact me. Just wire the credits to my account and move yourself in.


"Seashell Hut" Guesthouse

Three-story stone courtyard house. Ten rooms total. Shared kitchen on every floor.
Perfect for group getaways. Services include: Tide schedules, fishing gear rentals, and more.
Rent: Single Room 200 Credits/Day; Double Room 350 Credits/Day.
Contact: No phones, no social media. If you need anything, just give a holler at the village entrance.
